blocks.text: Upar wale 3 4 2 * + jaise postfix expressions ko stack se hal kiya ja sakta hai. Qadam ba qadam tareeqa yeh hai. Misal: postfix expression 3 4 5 * + ko stack se hal karein.

items: Expression ko baen se daen parhein.
Number mile to use stack par push karein.
Operator mile to zaroorat ke hisab se items (yahan do) stack se pop karein, operation karein, aur result (nateeja) wapas stack par push karein.
* mila: 5 aur 4 pop kiye, multiply (zarb) kiya: 4 * 5 = 20
+ mila: 20 aur 3 pop kiye, add (jama) kiya: 3 + 20 = 23
Aakhir mein stack par jo value bachti hai, wohi jawab hai: 23.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ke numbering mein chauthe qadam ko phir se 1 likha gaya hai; asal mein yeh chautha qadam hai: operator mile to do numbers pop karo, hisab karo, result push karo.

blocks.alt: 3 4 5 * + ko baen se daen parhte hue stack: 3 push, 4 push, 5 push; * par 5 aur 4 nikal kar 20 push (stack 3, 20); + par 20 aur 3 nikal kar 23 push. Aakhir mein stack mein sirf 23.

blocks.text: Yeh program postfix expression ko stack se hal karta hai: number push, operator par do pop, hisab, aur result push. postfix badal kar Run karein, maslan "3 4 2 * +" (jawab 11); har token ke beech space rakhein.

postfix = "3 4 5 * +"   # put a space between every token

stack = list()
for token in postfix.split():
    if token in "+-*/":
        b = stack.pop()
        a = stack.pop()
        if token == "+": result = a + b
        elif token == "-": result = a - b
        elif token == "*": result = a * b
        else: result = a / b
        print(a, token, b, "=", result)
        stack.append(result)
    else:
        stack.append(int(token))
    print("Stack:", stack)
print("Answer:", stack[0])

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"postfix = "3 4 5 * +"": postfix expression; har token ke beech space hai.
"stack = list()": numbers rakhne ke liye khali stack.
"for token in postfix.split():": har token baari baari.
"if token in "+-*/":": token operator hai to stack se do numbers pop hote hain. Pehle pop wala b (right wala number) aur doosre pop wala a (left wala) hai; yeh order - aur / ke liye zaroori hai.
"if token == "+": result = a + b" (aur baaqi elif): operator ke mutabiq hisab hota hai.
"print(a, token, b, "=", result)" aur "stack.append(result)": hisab dikhata hai aur jawab wapas stack par push karta hai.
"else: stack.append(int(token))": number ho to int() se text ko integer bana kar push karta hai.
"print("Stack:", stack)": har token ke baad stack dikhata hai.
"print("Answer:", stack[0])": aakhir mein stack mein sirf ek number bachta hai, wahi jawab hai.
Output: Stack [3], [3, 4], [3, 4, 5]; phir "4 * 5 = 20", Stack [3, 20]; phir "3 + 20 = 23", Stack [23]; aakhir mein "Answer: 23".
Khud try karein: postfix = "6 2 /" kar ke Run karein: "Answer: 3.0" aayega; Python mein / hamesha decimal (float) jawab deta hai.

items: Postfix hal karna: number push; operator par do pop, hisab, result push; 3 4 5 * + = 23.
